findings_a: chr1:145927447 C>T het, c.-21G>A (rs139428292), a low-expression allele: TAR syndrome with a null allele such as the 1q21.1 deletion on the other copy, a hypomorph allele
findings_b: chr1:145924501 A>G het, Pathogenic, 2 stars, ClinVar 90000
explanation: Both partners carry a change in RBM8A, linked to Thrombocytopenia-absent radius syndrome (autosomal recessive). A child who inherits the change of each parent can have the condition: 1 in 4 per pregnancy. The change of A is a low-function (hypomorph) allele, not a full loss of function: with the other parent's loss-of-function change a child can have the condition, for some genes in a milder form; two such alleles alone are set aside.
